001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.Comparator;
005import java.util.List;
006import java.util.Map;
007import java.util.Objects;
008import java.util.Optional;
009import java.util.ServiceLoader;
010import java.util.WeakHashMap;
011import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;
012import java.util.stream.Stream;
013
014import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
015
016import io.avaje.spi.Service;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAlerts;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
019import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
020import io.jstach.rainbowgum.RainbowGum;
021import io.jstach.rainbowgum.ServiceRegistry;
022
023/**
024 * RainbowGum SPI. The Rainbow Gum SPI uses the {@link ServiceLoader} with the
025 * registration of <strong>this class</strong> and <em>NOT the <code>non-sealed</code>
026 * subclasses!</em> Read the {@link ServiceLoader} doc to understand how to register a
027 * service loader class. A common option is to use an annotation processor to generate the
028 * <code>META-INF/services</code> registration. There are several libraries that can do
029 * this:
030 *
031 * <ul>
032 * <li><a href="https://avaje.io/spi/">Avaje SPI's</a> <code>@ServiceProvider</code>
033 * <li><a href="https://github.com/kohsuke/metainf-services">metainf-services</a>
034 * <code>@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)</code>
035 * <li><a href="https://github.com/jstachio/pistachio#serviceloader-helper">Pistachio
036 * SVC's</a> <code>@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)</code>
037 * </ul>
038 *
039 * However, if your application is fully modularized (has a <code>module-info.java</code>)
040 * you will also need to use the module-info syntax:
041 *
042 * {@snippet :
043 *
044 * provides io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider with com.mycompany.SomeService;
045 *
046 * }
047 *
048 * <strong>Initialization Order:</strong>
049 *
050 * <ol>
051 * <li>{@link PropertiesProvider}
052 * <li>{@link Configurator}
053 * <li>{@link RainbowGumProvider}
054 * </ol>
055 */
056@Service
057@SuppressWarnings("InvalidInlineTag")
058public sealed interface RainbowGumServiceProvider {
059
060        /**
061         * Provides properties and or register services.
062         */
063        public non-sealed interface PropertiesProvider extends RainbowGumServiceProvider {
064
065                /**
066                 * Provides properties and or register services. <em>If just registering services
067                 * and not providing properies an empty list can be returned. </em>
068                 * @param registry registry is usually empty here.
069                 * @param alerts records alerts into the configured {@link LogConfig#alerts()}.
070                 * Alerts recorded before it exists are replayed into it once it does, and this
071                 * instance keeps forwarding afterwards, so it may be retained and used after the
072                 * provider returns. Listener registration is not supported.
073                 * @return list of properties.
074                 */
075                List<LogProperties> provideProperties(ServiceRegistry registry, LogAlerts alerts);
076
077        }
078
079        /**
080         * Providers sometimes need multiple passes to support dependencies without using true
081         * dependency injection.
082         */
083        public enum Pass {
084
085                /**
086                 * First pass.
087                 */
088                FIRST,
089                /**
090                 * Second or greater pass but not the last pass.
091                 */
092                MIDDLE,
093                /**
094                 * The last pass to return true otherwise Rainbow Gum will fail to load. This
095                 * state is useful if a provider can provide a better error by throwing an
096                 * exception.
097                 */
098                LAST;
099
100                static Pass of(int pass, int total) {
101                        if (pass >= (total - 1)) {
102                                return LAST;
103                        }
104                        if (pass == 0) {
105                                return FIRST;
106                        }
107                        return MIDDLE;
108                }
109
110        }
111
112        /**
113         * The default amount of passes made to resolve registrators or configurators.
114         */
115        public static int PASSES = 4;
116
117        /**
118         * Called after {@link LogConfig} has been loaded to do various custom initialization
119         * like registering {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput.OutputProvider}s.
120         * <p>
121         * The configurator has the option to return <code>false</code> to indicate a retry
122         * needs to be made. This is a simple way to handle dependency needs of one
123         * configurator needing another to run prior.
124         *
125         * @see LogConfig#outputRegistry()
126         * @see ServiceRegistry
127         */
128        @FunctionalInterface // TODO remove and make the builder take a function
129        public non-sealed interface Configurator extends RainbowGumServiceProvider {
130
131                /**
132                 * Do ad-hoc initialization before RainbowGum is fully loaded.
133                 * @param config config.
134                 * @param pass info on what pass this is.
135                 * @return <code>true</code> if all dependencies were found.
136                 */
137                boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass);
138
139                /**
140                 * The default amount of passes made to resolve configurators.
141                 */
142                public static int CONFIGURATOR_PASSES = PASSES;
143
144                /**
145                 * Runs configurators. If a configurator returns false then it will be retried.
146                 * The default of {@value #CONFIGURATOR_PASSES} passes will be tried.
147                 * @param configurators stream of configurators.
148                 * @param config config to use for registration.
149                 * @throws IllegalStateException if there are configurators still returning
150                 * <code>false</code>.
151                 */
152                public static void runConfigurators(Stream<? extends RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator> configurators,
153                                LogConfig config) {
154                        runConfigurators(configurators, config, CONFIGURATOR_PASSES);
155                }
156
157                /**
158                 * Runs configurators. If a configurator returns false then it will be retried.
159                 * @param configurators stream of configurators.
160                 * @param config config to use for registration.
161                 * @param passes number of times to retry configurator if it returns
162                 * @throws IllegalStateException if there are configurators still returning
163                 * <code>false</code>.
164                 */
165                private static void runConfigurators(Stream<? extends RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator> configurators,
166                                LogConfig config, int passes) {
167                        List<Configurator> unresolved = new ArrayList<>(
168                                        configurators.sorted(Comparator.comparingInt(Configurator::priority).reversed()).toList());
169                        for (int i = 0; i < passes; i++) {
170                                var it = unresolved.iterator();
171                                while (it.hasNext()) {
172                                        var c = it.next();
173                                        if (c.configure(config, Pass.of(i, passes))) {
174                                                it.remove();
175                                                if (c instanceof AutoCloseable ac) {
176                                                        config.serviceRegistry().onClose(ac);
177                                                }
178                                        }
179                                }
180                                if (unresolved.isEmpty()) {
181                                        break;
182                                }
183                        }
184                        if (!unresolved.isEmpty()) {
185                                throw new IllegalStateException("Configurators could not find dependencies (returned false) after "
186                                                + passes + " passes. configurators = " + unresolved);
187                        }
188
189                }
190
191                /**
192                 * Priority of configurators.
193                 * @return priority order where higher number means it will be tried earlier.
194                 */
195                default int priority() {
196                        return 0;
197                }
198
199        }
200
201        /**
202         * Implement to create a custom RainbowGum. This is the preferred way to customize
203         * RainbowGum publishers, appenders, and outputs.
204         */
205        public non-sealed interface RainbowGumProvider extends RainbowGumServiceProvider {
206
207                /**
208                 * Optionally provides a rainbow gum based on config.
209                 * @param config config loaded.
210                 * @return a Rainbow Gum or not.
211                 */
212                Optional<RainbowGum> provide(LogConfig config);
213
214                /**
215                 * If there are multiple rainbow gum providers found the higher priority ones are
216                 * tried first ({@link #provide(LogConfig)}). The default is {@code 0}.
217                 * <p>
218                 * This feature allows custom rainbow gums for different environments like a
219                 * testing version that lives in its own jar that is in Maven scope test. If its
220                 * priority is higher and {@link #provide(LogConfig)} returns a non-empty optional
221                 * then it will be used instead of than the production Rainbow Gum.
222                 * @return priority order where higher number means it will be tried earlier.
223                 */
224                default int priority() {
225                        return 0;
226                }
227
228        }
229
230        /**
231         * This is a marker interface that indicates that a facade implementation will do the
232         * eager loading of RainbowGum. This is used to determine if another facade that has
233         * the option to queue should queue and not load rainbowgum if any implementations are
234         * found of this interface.
235         *
236         * @apiNote Only facade implementers need concern themselves with this interface and
237         * for others it is an internal detail.
238         * @see #exists()
239         */
240        public non-sealed interface RainbowGumEagerLoad extends RainbowGumServiceProvider {
241
242                /**
243                 * Without loading service providers will carefully check for the existence of any
244                 * {@link RainbowGumEagerLoad} implementations.
245                 * @return true if something is marked as eager.
246                 */
247                public static boolean exists() {
248                        var sl = ServiceLoaderCache.SERVICE_LOADER_CACHE.findServiceLoader();
249                        return sl.stream()
250                                .filter(p -> RainbowGumEagerLoad.class.isAssignableFrom(p.type()))
251                                .findFirst()
252                                .isPresent();
253                }
254
255        }
256
257        /**
258         * Finds service providers based on type.
259         * @param <T> provider interface type.
260         * @param loader service loader to use.
261         * @param providerType provider class.
262         * @return stream containing only provider of the given type.
263         */
264        public static <T extends RainbowGumServiceProvider> Stream<T> findProviders(
265                        ServiceLoader<RainbowGumServiceProvider> loader, Class<T> providerType) {
266                return loader.stream().flatMap(p -> {
267                        if (providerType.isAssignableFrom(p.type())) {
268                                var s = providerType.cast(p.get());
269                                return Stream.of(s);
270                        }
271                        return Stream.empty();
272                });
273        }
274
275        /**
276         * Creates config from service loader.
277         * @param loader service loader.
278         * @return config.
279         */
280        public static LogConfig provideConfig(ServiceLoader<RainbowGumServiceProvider> loader) {
281                return LogConfig.builder().serviceLoader(loader).build();
282        }
283
284        /**
285         * Will load all RainbowGum SPI to create a RainbowGum powered from the ServiceLoader.
286         * @param loader service loader to use.
287         * @return Rainbow Gum.
288         */
289        public static RainbowGum provide(ServiceLoader<RainbowGumServiceProvider> loader) {
290                var config = provideConfig(loader);
291                @Nullable RainbowGum gum = findProviders(loader, RainbowGumProvider.class)
292                        .sorted(Comparator.comparingInt(RainbowGumProvider::priority).reversed())
293                        .flatMap(s -> s.provide(config).stream())
294                        .findFirst()
295                        .orElse(null);
296
297                if (gum == null) {
298                        gum = RainbowGum.builder(config).build();
299                }
300                return gum;
301        }
302
303        /**
304         * Will load all RainbowGum SPI to create a RainbowGum powered from the ServiceLoader
305         * using the current thread context class loader if avaiable otherwise the system
306         * classloader.
307         * @return Rainbow Gum.
308         */
309        public static RainbowGum provide() {
310                // TODO perhaps we should use RainbowGum.class classloader
311                return provide(cachedServiceLoader(Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader()));
312        }
313
314        private static ServiceLoader<RainbowGumServiceProvider> cachedServiceLoader(@Nullable ClassLoader classLoader) {
315                if (classLoader == null) {
316                        return ServiceLoaderCache.SERVICE_LOADER_CACHE.findServiceLoader();
317                }
318                return ServiceLoaderCache.SERVICE_LOADER_CACHE.serviceLoader(classLoader);
319        }
320
321}
322
323@SuppressWarnings("ImmutableEnumChecker")
324enum ServiceLoaderCache {
325
326        SERVICE_LOADER_CACHE;
327
328        private final Map<ClassLoader, ServiceLoader<RainbowGumServiceProvider>> serviceLoaderCache = new WeakHashMap<>();
329
330        private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
331
332        static ClassLoader defaultClassLoader() {
333                // TODO perhaps we should use RainbowGum.class classloader
334                return ClassLoader.getSystemClassLoader();
335        }
336
337        ServiceLoader<RainbowGumServiceProvider> serviceLoader(ClassLoader classLoader) {
338                lock.writeLock().lock();
339                try {
340                        var sl = serviceLoaderCache.computeIfAbsent(classLoader, cl -> {
341                                return ServiceLoader.load(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class, classLoader);
342                        });
343                        return Objects.requireNonNull(sl);
344                }
345                finally {
346                        lock.writeLock().unlock();
347                }
348        }
349
350        private @Nullable ServiceLoader<RainbowGumServiceProvider> _findServiceLoader(
351                        @Nullable ClassLoader[] classLoaders) {
352                for (var cl : classLoaders) {
353                        if (cl != null) {
354                                var sl = serviceLoaderCache.get(cl);
355                                if (sl != null) {
356                                        return sl;
357                                }
358                        }
359                }
360                return null;
361        }
362
363        ServiceLoader<RainbowGumServiceProvider> findServiceLoader() {
364                @Nullable ServiceLoader<RainbowGumServiceProvider> loader = null;
365                @Nullable ClassLoader[] classLoaders = new @Nullable ClassLoader[] { Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader(),
366                                ServiceLoaderCache.class.getClassLoader(), defaultClassLoader() };
367                lock.readLock().lock();
368                try {
369                        loader = _findServiceLoader(classLoaders);
370                }
371                finally {
372                        lock.readLock().unlock();
373                }
374                if (loader != null) {
375                        return loader;
376                }
377                return serviceLoader(defaultClassLoader());
378        }
379
380}
